items.summary: Symforce-Caspar CASPAR-accelerated bundle adjustment (src/thirdparty/Symforce-Caspar, 482 generated .cu, Apache-2.0) scoped out of the colmap GPU SIFT port. Blocker is cooperative groups, not symbol renaming: 2392 references including cg::labeled_partition, cg::binary_partition, cg::coalesced_threads, cg::memcpy_async, cg::reduce and cg::this_grid, several of which have no HIP analogue. generated/{f32,f64}/CMakeLists.txt pins CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES 75 80 86 89 with the comment 'sm_75 minimum required by cooperative_groups::reduce'. cub::DeviceReduce::Sum and cub::DeviceRadixSort::SortPairs/SortKeys map to hipCUB cleanly and are not the blocker. The code is generated, so a real fix belongs in caspar_generate.py rather than in the generated files. CASPAR_ENABLED defaults OFF and CASPAR_ENABLED AND NOT CUDA_ENABLED is already a FATAL_ERROR, so a ROCm build is unaffected today.

COLMAP GPU SIFT ExtractSiftFeaturesGPU.Nominal heap-corrupts on Windows in SiftGPU PyramidCU destructor glDeleteBuffers: OpenGLContextManager::MakeCurrent (opengl_utils.cc:80-86) makes the GL context current on a temporary joined std::thread, leaving it owned by a dead thread; destructor deletes buffers with no current context. Pre-existing upstream COLMAP Windows bug in code unmodified by the port; strict Windows AMD ICD does not tolerate it (Linux Mesa does). Fix upstream (make context current on the destructing thread, or guard glDeleteBuffers on a current context) as a separate non-ROCm change; do not bundle into moat-port. Blocks windows gate unless waived.
